picker_blurb: Bruiser tank: takes the hits, swings back harder
flavor: Hired for the size, kept for the temper. The Muscle takes the first punch so they can throw the last one.

picker_blurb: Aggressive tank: extra attacks, slows the table down
flavor: Circles the table, waits for blood in the water, then takes three bites before you've even called.

picker_blurb: Bodyguard: buffs the whole party and draws every hit
flavor: Somebody's gotta look after the high rollers. The Minder pumps up the whole table and makes sure every punch lands on them first.

picker_blurb: Debt-collector tank: weakens every enemy's attack, hits twice, +25% loot
flavor: Everybody owes somebody. The Collector takes the swing out of the whole other side, then comes back for a second payment.

picker_blurb: Corner-man: stuns, heals, and hits back with a big ATK boost
flavor: Patches you up between rounds, stays on their feet, and when the bell rings they throw a punch like they've been saving it.

picker_blurb: Fixer: cleanses, big party attack boosts, shreds armor
flavor: Nothing happens on this floor without a phone call. The Fixer wipes the bad luck off your crew and juices everyone's swing.

picker_blurb: Devoted healer: heals over time, shields the party, burns enemies slowly
flavor: Blesses the whole room and keeps the healing coming long after the sermon's over. Hecklers get a slow burn.

picker_blurb: Dealer: party dodge, armor shred, lifesteal, +25% loot
flavor: First taste is free. The Pusher keeps the crew slippery and leaves the other side paying for a bad batch.
Every spell's a coin flip on a hot table. When it hits, it hits everything. When it doesn't... nobody saw that coming.

picker_blurb: Curse caster: area damage over time, armor shred
flavor: They sit down and the whole table's luck goes sour. The curses stack up turn after turn until somebody's holding the dead man's hand.

picker_blurb: Showman: area damage, party dodge and ATK boosts
flavor: The whole room's watching, and they love it. Every spell plays to the crowd, and the Enchanter's friends get a little lighter on their feet.

picker_blurb: Rigged caster: area damage, massive charge-ups, triple hits, +25% loot
flavor: A card mechanic with a soldering iron. Charges up way past what's safe, then deals themselves three extra cards in a row.

picker_blurb: Brawler: heavy single hits and stuns
flavor: Doesn't need a con when there's a bar stool handy. Hits like a closing-time brawl and the next round's always on them.

picker_blurb: Assassin: extra-hit burst, stuns, party dodge and resist
flavor: A professional. The exit's planned for the whole crew before the job starts, and the mark never sees the second shot.

picker_blurb: Charmer: guarded strikes, party healing and buffs, stuns and armor shred
flavor: Makes every mark feel like the only one in the room. While they're blushing, the crew gets dealt back in and the mark's guard comes down.

picker_blurb: Gambler: executes weakened enemies, coin-flip hits, +25% loot
flavor: Plays the long game for the biggest pot. Finishes off anyone running low and never tells you which plan was the real one.
